definitions.top_region: y > 2.3 wu; fixed spatial bunny region
definitions.top_density: mean raw neighbors within target median r8, excluding self, divided by 8
definitions.top_under_half: fraction of top particles with fewer than 4 raw neighbors within r8
definitions.tip_n: raw count within 0.25 wu of target maximum-y particle
definitions.target_near_frac: target particles within 2 target native spacings of source cloud
definitions.progress: first crossing of fixed fraction of initial symmetric mean NN distance

common_material_cohort_tail.definition: union of both endpoint low-density surfaces minus each endpoint admitted pins; fixed material IDs
common_material_cohort_tail.surface_rule: raw neighbor count at radius 2 source native spacings < 0.6 median count
common_material_cohort_tail.selection_limitation: symmetric endpoint-selected cohort; descriptive, not pre-treatment sampling

on.attempts_scope: optimizer calls in complete original run, including after delivery

tail_unpinned_surface.cohort: surface and unpinned at delivered endpoint; fixed cohort across tail

off.attempts_scope: optimizer calls in complete original run, including after delivery

tail_unpinned_surface.cohort: surface and unpinned at delivered endpoint; fixed cohort across tail
